detector_seed_policy.seed1_seed2: final main-result robustness only; excluded from sensitivity and parameter selection

qccr_lambda.evaluation: image-level five-fold OOF Val COCO evaluation
qccr_lambda.fit: original balanced-BCE QCCR fit with image-level five-fold splits
qccr_lambda.legacy_decision_token_scope: OOF_VAL_GO is a legacy activation token for applying the predeclared fixed protocol; it does not mean that the selected candidate passed all diagnostic guards
qccr_lambda.measurement_plan: import the SHA-verified existing four-candidate fits and OOF-Val COCO evidence
qccr_lambda.ranking: diagnostic counterfactual only; current-seed reselection was disabled and the frozen value was not chosen by this ranking
qccr_lambda.reuse_policy: reuse the original complete candidate/OOF evidence when SHA-verified; otherwise rerun the identical Val-only protocol
qccr_lambda.selection_basis: predeclared fixed lambda_reg=0.001; current-seed OOF guards are diagnostic and were not used for reselection
qccr_lambda.sensitivity_plot: OOF Val AP versus lambda_reg on a log-scaled x-axis; mark 1e-3

reporting.figure_handoff: unrounded numerical evidence; publication layouts prepared separately
reporting.numerical_archive: QCCR imports verified original OOF records; UMR stores only newly evaluated corrected-semantics pw4 tau-by-beta results. The pre-correction 60-row UMR grid remains quarantined as historical provenance and is excluded from figures and claims.
panels: (a) LCCT delta versus native Val AP
(b) QCCR lambda_reg versus OOF Val AP
(c) UMR tau-by-beta heatmap of Val delta AP at pw=4 and topk=300

split_policy.inference_side: Train/Val according to the original QCCR/UMR protocol
split_policy.test: PROHIBITED for all sensitivity measurement, ranking, guards, and revisions
split_policy.training_side: Train for fitting and Val for checkpoint/result reporting

study_role: post-finalization robustness analysis; not retrospective Test optimization

training_side.all_other_settings: byte/config identical to the final seed0 training protocol
training_side.center_policy: reuse the exact final seed0 run only after source/config/log/checkpoint SHA verification
training_side.checkpoint_rule: within each level, use the checkpoint selected by maximum native Val AP; no Test tie-break
training_side.interpretation: sensitivity curve only; no level may replace the frozen final setting

umr_tau_beta.aggregation: arithmetic mean across the three UMR head-fit seeds
umr_tau_beta.head_seed_definition: three lightweight MLP fits on the same detector-seed0 Train captures; not detector seeds

legacy_positive_weight_and_full_grid.reason: generated before correction of disjoint-competitor feature semantics

umr_tau_beta.measurement_plan: use the three SHA-verified corrected pw4 heads and frozen Val capture; run tau-by-beta grid evaluation only
umr_tau_beta.positive_weight_policy: pw=4 remains fixed by the frozen final method; no pw sensitivity is claimed under protocol v1.1
umr_tau_beta.primary_heatmap_value: Val delta AP in percentage points versus QCCR Val baseline
umr_tau_beta.selection_score_and_guards: retain the original final-source composite score, safety guards, and AP/AP75 tie-break exactly
umr_tau_beta.topk_policy: fixed source candidate budget; no candidate grid and no sensitivity sweep
